49.note: Neil's cottage cutscene always runs: it locks the joypad at spawn and releases it when its script ends; no flag skips it.

67.note: Erik's cry locks the joypad (zone-gated) while the cry flag is clear and the vampires' script releases it; with the vampire reward flag set the vampires do not exist, so with the cry flag clear the lock never ends. The vampires lock again before the fight setup.

78.note: The arrival actor locks the joypad at spawn while the arrival-cutscene flag is clear.

79.note: Lance's scene in Luke's house locks the joypad when his father's visit is done and the exchange flag, the festival flag and the glass-game flag are clear.

82.note: The trail intro locks the joypad at spawn on the first visit and sets the intro flag.

89.note: An ending scene: it locks the joypad at spawn and queues the next ending scene itself.

90.note: An ending scene: it locks the joypad at spawn and queues the next ending scene itself.

96.note: Neil's greeting locks the joypad while the greeting, morning and Hamlet flags are clear; the morning scene locks when the morning flag is set and the Hamlet flag is clear.

97.note: The clerks lock the joypad depending on the player's spawn pixel (no flag test) and the second clerk releases it.

E6.note: The Dark Space hub starts free: Gaia's talk locks the joypad only after the player talks to Gaia (GaiaDialogueEntry) and the exit sequence locks it when the player leaves.

FA.note: The diary menu scene is not an adventure scene: its actor masks input at spawn and the menu drives the next scene change; no flag is tested.

FB.note: The boot logo scene masks input at spawn and queues the title screen itself.

FC.note: The title scene masks input at spawn and queues the prologue or the diary menu from the title handler.

FD.note: The statue ceremony scene locks input at spawn; the ceremony index in $0AAC selects the sequence and the scene returns to the caller itself.

FE.note: The world map is driven by WorldMapController (staged position and destination menu); it masks input at spawn and releases it for the menu. No flag gates the scene itself; the exit menus of the town scenes gate the destinations.

FF.note: The inventory scene has no inbound scene-change edge: the menu overlay enters it. No entry class applies.
FF.source: absence: no QueueMapChange or scene-warp destination $FF in extracted/ (plans/flags/tools/fl32_scenes.mjs reach: the only scene without an inbound edge)

8D.note: A self-advancing legend narration: the shared start handler masks input at spawn.

8E.note: A self-advancing narration: the shared start handler masks input at spawn.

08.note: The priest locks the joypad at spawn while the lesson flag is clear, plays the lesson text and sets the flag at its end; with the flag set the priest is a plain NPC.

02.note: The entry actor locks the joypad at spawn on the first visit, prints the cave narration and unlocks; with the intro flag set it only guards the exit row.

06.note: Three arrival scripts depend on the story state: Hamlet locks the joypad when the cave news is done and neither the Kara intro nor the soldier scene is done; the morning monologue locks when the dinner night has passed and the morning flag is clear; Kara's return locks when the throne room is done and Lily is not yet met. Setting one flag of each exclusion group frees the arrival; in any other story state the scene is free.

0A.note: The left guard locks the joypad at spawn while the letter flag and the throne-room flag are both clear, plays the guard's steps and the letter dialog, sets the letter flag and unlocks by itself; no player input is needed.

0B.note: The cell actor locks the joypad at spawn while the cell-door flag is clear, prints Will's imprisonment text and unlocks; later phases lock again after waits on scratch flags.

1B.note: The trial actor locks the joypad at spawn while the trial-done word flag is clear.

1D.note: The cliff monologue locks the joypad at spawn on the first visit (flag 6C clear) and sets the flag.

4B.note: Neil's Nazca scene always runs: it locks the joypad at spawn and releases it when its script ends; no flag skips it.

5A.note: The palace monologue locks the joypad at spawn and releases it in the same pass when the arrival flag is set, otherwise after the text; the same actor serves scenes 5A, 5F and 61 with their own latch.

5D.note: The fountain actor locks the joypad at scene load when Lilly's pocket scene is done, the fountain is not yet purified and the Purification Stone is held; with the purified flag set it does nothing.

5F.note: The shared palace monologue actor locks the joypad at spawn and releases it in the same pass when the Mu arrival flag is set.

freeDefaultNote: No actor placed in the scene writes the joypad lock mask on a path from its actor-def entry that has no halt before it and no position, item, proximity or button condition. Some of these scenes hold later in-scene cutscenes that lock the joypad after a trigger; they do not affect the arrival.
freeDefaultSource: absence: for every actor-def of the actor files placed by extracted/tables/scene_actors.asm for the scene (engine actors under actors/ excluded) the guard analysis of plans/flags/tools/fl32_guards.mjs (entry-only mode, per placed label) found no TSB/ORA/STA to $joypadMaskStd with an empty halt-and-condition set; locks written by spawned children or later handlers were not searched; offset: not available
